0.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDSHOP_00312_JAQUOINIE_000_000
0.description: Will you be registering for the next mission? If so, you will need to submit proof of purchase for a tank of ceruleum.
0.translation_description: Vuoi iscriverti alla prossima missione? In tal caso, dovrai presentare la prova d'acquisto per un serbatoio di ceruleo.

1.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDSHOP_00312_JAQUOINIE_000_010
1.description: ...Ah, a thousand pardons, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>. Due to the dangers our parties often face on these expeditions, we can accept only the most experienced individuals.
1.translation_description: ... Mi perdoni, <hex:020817E905FF0A7369676E6F72696E61FF087369676E6F726503>. A causa dei pericoli che i nostri gruppi affrontano durante queste spedizioni, possiamo accettare solo chi ha molta esperienza.

2.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDSHOP_00312_SYSTEM_000_011
2.description: In order to embark upon an Ishgardian exploratory mission, you and your party must meet the following requirements:
2.translation_description: Per partecipare a una missione esplorativa di Ishgard, tu e il tuo gruppo dovete soddisfare i seguenti requisiti:

3.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDSHOP_00312_SYSTEM_000_012
3.description: ※You must have completed the main scenario quest “Heavensward.”
3.translation_description: ※Devi aver completato la missione dello scenario principale «Heavensward».

4.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDSHOP_00312_SYSTEM_000_013
4.description: You must be a level 60 Disciple of War or Magic.
4.translation_description: Devi essere un Discepolo della Guerra o della Magia di livello 60.

5.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDSHOP_00312_SYSTEM_000_014
5.description: To review your quest progression, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Duty<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the main menu, followed by <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Journal<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
5.translation_description: Per controllare l'avanzamento delle missioni, seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Incarichi<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> dal menu principale, poi <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Diario di Viaggio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

6.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDSHOP_00312_JAQUOINIE_000_020
6.description: Wait─have you spoken with Lord Aurvael yet? I thought not. It would be best if you did so first.
6.translation_description: Aspetta, hai già parlato con Lord Aurvael? Immaginavo di no. È meglio che tu ci parli prima.

7.name: TEXT_REGROC2SKYISLANDSHOP_00312_Q1_000_000
7.description: What would you like to do?
